record.paper_title: Some open problems in low dimensional dynamical systems
record.original_question: Let F: ℝ² → ℝ² be a smooth map with a fixed point such that the spectral radius of |DF(x)| is less than 1 for every x ∈ ℝ². Determine whether the fixed point must be globally asymptotically stable.

evidence.quote: Problem 20. LetF : R2→R2 be a smooth map having a ﬁxed point and such that ρ(|DF(x)|)< 1, for all x∈R2. Is it true that the ﬁxed point is globally asymptotically stable?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $F:\mathbb{R}^2\to\mathbb{R}^2$ be a smooth map possessing a fixed point $p\in\mathbb{R}^2$ (i.e. $F(p)=p$). For $x\in\mathbb{R}^2$, let $DF(x)$ denote the Jacobian matrix of $F$ at $x$, let $|DF(x)|$ denote the $2\times 2$ matrix obtained from $DF(x)$ by replacing each entry with its absolute value, and let $\rho(M)$ denote the spectral radius (the maximum modulus of the eigenvalues) of a square matrix $M$. Assume that
$$\rho(|DF(x)|) < 1 \quad \text{for every } x\in\mathbb{R}^2.$$
Consider the discrete dynamical system defined by iteration of $F$, namely $x_{n+1}=F(x_n)$ for $n\ge 0$. Decide whether the fixed point $p$ must be globally asymptotically stable, that is, whether $p$ is Lyapunov stable and $\lim_{n\to\infty} F^n(x)=p$ for every $x\in\mathbb{R}^2$.
artifact.status_search_result: The discrete Markus–Yamabe / La Salle stability question in the plane under the strong hypothesis that the spectral radius of the entry-wise absolute-value Jacobian is less than 1 appears in the literature as an open problem. Counterexamples for related discrete Markus–Yamabe-type conjectures are known in dimension ≥ 3 (Cima–van den Essen–Gasull–Hubbers–Mañosas), but the planar case under such spectral-radius hypotheses on |DF| remains unresolved according to surveys of examples and counterexamples for Markus–Yamabe and La Salle problems.

status_evidence.title: Examples and counterexamples for Markus-Yamabe and La Salle problems
status_evidence.snippet: It only remains to study the following problem... Is the origin GAS for the discrete dynamical system?
status_evidence.claim: Survey lists the analogous discrete planar GAS question under spectral-radius hypotheses as still open.

status_evidence.title: The Discrete and Continuous Markus-Yamabe Stability Conjectures
status_evidence.snippet: discrete-time analog of the Conjecture – the key difference being that one supposes that the Jacobian is everywhere Schur
status_evidence.claim: The discrete Markus–Yamabe conjecture is known false in dimensions ≥ 3, but variants in dimension 2 remain studied.

status_evidence.title: Markus–Yamabe conjecture - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: A polynomial counterexample in all dimensions ≥3
status_evidence.claim: Establishes that counterexamples exist for n ≥ 3, motivating the planar question.
